notes.title: Hare In The Hat: The Abyss Release!
notes.notes:
Today we are proud to present second chapter of the Hare In The Hat game! There are 17 new achievements and overall more than 90 minutes of gameplay with 10 new puzzles!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/460890/

notes.title: DLC Release date
notes.notes:
Today we are proud to announce second chapter of Hare In The Hat game! Chapter is called The Abyss and the action takes place underwater, on the board of the sunken ship. It will be available on Steam as DLC at April 29 and as a separate game in mobile markets.

There will be new achievements, new trade cards and overall more than 90 minutes of gameplay with 10 new puzzles!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/460890

notes.title: Release date!
notes.notes:
I want to greet all of followers with our official release date: HIH will be available on Steam staring at Apr 1, 2015 PDT!
We come a long way from a concept to mobile app and then to full-featured desktop game. But even more, right now second chapter is under development and it is expected in Q3 2015!
Stay tuned for more data, game art, PDF manual with game hints, other languages and much more on this community forum.
